text: The plan emphasizes a multi-stakeholder governance mechanism led by MoWRAM, integrating national and basin-level coordination. It includes comprehensive risk assessments and prioritizes early warning systems to reach vulnerable populations. The initiative also focuses on climate-resilient infrastructure and water-use efficiency, supported by regional and international collaborations. Capacity development is a key component, with training and knowledge exchange facilitated by international partners.
